corrections.old_text: ፋል ፡ ፪ ፡ ተሰ ፡ ፭ ፥ ፪ ። ቍ ፡ ፯ ። ማቴ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ፋል ፡ ፩ ፡ ተሰ ፡ ፭ ፥ ፪ ። ቍ ፡ ፯ ። ማቴ ፡
corrections.reason: The printed numeral before 'ተሰ' (Thessalonians) is '፩' (1 Thessalonians 5:2, which speaks of the day of the Lord coming as a thief), misread as '፪' due to heavy top/bottom bars.
